# `tfctl profile get`

The `tfctl profile get` command gets a tfctl CLI configuration property.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile get PROPERTY
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile get` command gets the specified property in your active profile.

To view currently set properties, run [`tfctl profile display`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/display) or run [`tfctl profile set`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/set) to set the value of an individual property.

Refer to [Available properties](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile#available-properties) for a list of the properties that can be configured for each profile.

## Arguments

- `PROPERTY`: (Required) Property to get, such as `organization` and `hostname`.

## Output

The command outputs the property value to stdout. If the property is not set, an error is returned.

For JSON output format, use the `--json` global flag:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile get hostname --json
```

## Exit codes

- `0`: Property retrieved successfully
- `1`: Property not found or not set

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to get profile configuration properties.

### Get the default organization

The following example retrieves the default organization setting from the active profile.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile get default_organization
```

### Get the hostname

The following example retrieves the hostname setting from the active profile.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile get hostname
```

### Get the telemetry setting

The following example retrieves the telemetry setting from the active profile.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile get telemetry
```
